transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling down for a long time. Kind of flat and heavy most days, even when things at work are okay or people are decent to me. It’s like I still feel empty.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About two years, a little more… maybe two years and two months. It started around when that dashboard project at work kind of put me in the spotlight.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like before you started feeling this way?
I don’t know… I guess I haven’t really paid attention. Things don’t feel the same, but it’s hard to say exactly.
Do you still find pleasure in activities or hobbies that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I still do some of the same things sometimes, but I don’t know if I’d call it pleasure exactly. It’s just kind of… there.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I don’t really know. Maybe a little, but I haven’t been paying close enough attention to say for sure.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that normally would bring you happiness?
I’m not sure I’d say unable. It’s more like… I don’t really notice much from things either way. Some stuff is fine, I guess, but I haven’t really thought about it like that.
Do you feel like things that used to make you happy no longer do?
I don’t know. Maybe not as much as before, but I can’t really tell if it’s that they don’t make me happy anymore or if I’m just not paying attention to it.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities or things that you used to enjoy?
I’m not really sure. I guess I still do some things, but I don’t pay much attention to whether I’m actually interested or just doing them.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since you started feeling this way?
Not really. I mean, I haven’t been tracking it closely, but I don’t think there’s been anything significant.
Have you been having any problems with your sleep?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid much attention to it. Some nights are probably better than others, I guess.
Do you often feel guilty about things?
I don’t know… not especially, I guess. I mean, I think about things I’ve done sometimes, but I wouldn’t say it’s guilt exactly.
Do you often feel tired?

Yeah… I guess so. By the afternoon I’m usually pretty wiped out. Even small stuff at work, like fixing a spreadsheet thing or doing expense paperwork, feels like I’m dragging myself through it. Soccer too, sometimes.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to or having trouble sitting still?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really noticed anything like that. Maybe I’m a little slower when I’m tired, but not in a way I’d really point to.
Do you often think about death?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think about it much. Maybe it crosses my mind like it does for anyone, but not often.
Do you often feel worthless?

Yeah… sometimes. It’s more like… even when people at work say something good, like about a dashboard I made, I kind of assume I just got lucky or fooled them. And if I miss a follow-up or send an email late, it feels like that’s the real proof I’m not actually that capable.
Have you ever thought about harming yourself?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t had thoughts like that.
Do you think about death more often than most people?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really compared it, but it doesn’t feel like something I think about a lot.
Do you think about death often?
Not really. I mean… no, I wouldn’t say often.
Do you think about death at all?
I mean… maybe in a general way sometimes, like anyone does. But not something I sit around thinking about.
Do you ever have thoughts that you would be better off dead?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I feel pretty worn down sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I think I’d be better off dead.
